badge.label: AI-generated
badge.tooltip: This content was produced by an automated system, not by a person.

inline.heading: AI-assisted result
inline.body: An automated system analysed your photo and suggested the equipment details and checklist below. It can be wrong. You are the inspector of record — review every line and correct anything that does not match the equipment in front of you.
inline.action: Your signature attests to the corrected result, not to the suggestion.

record.heading: Automated processing was used
record.body: Parts of this inspection record were generated with AI assistance. The provider and model are recorded with the inspection for traceability.

consent.heading: Photo analysis by a third-party AI provider
consent.body: When AI assistance is enabled, inspection photos are sent to a third-party model provider for analysis. Those providers are located in the United States. You can complete inspections without AI assistance.
